comment: ADR-016 D3 synthetic, non-sensitive input vectors for the cJSON differential-run harness. Each `stdin` is a benign JSON document fed (UTF-8) to BOTH builds — (A) the trusted cJSON source + differential_driver_cjson.c, and (B) the candidate recompiled renamed-decompiled-C + the same driver — under the TB5 sandbox. The driver parses stdin and prints a deterministic summary to stdout; the oracle compares (exit_code, stdout) byte-exactly (D2). NO real malware / no PII (master §5) — these are ordinary JSON literals and a couple of deliberately invalid documents to exercise the parse-failure path.
